# Horizon Vantage
> On-site photography, video and fast websites for local businesses - cafés, bakeries, barbershops, pet shops and other shops, holiday lets, glamping, B&Bs, experiences and artisan food and drink producers - based in Co. Wicklow, working across Ireland. One local specialist, from shoot to search.

## Who it's for
- [Cafés, bakeries & food producers](https://horizonvantage.ie/food-and-drink/): cafés, bakeries, farm shops, makers and artisan producers
- [Shops, salons & barbershops](https://horizonvantage.ie/photography/): pet shops, barbershops, salons, gyms and independent retailers
- [Stays & experiences](https://horizonvantage.ie/stays-and-experiences/): holiday lets, glamping, B&Bs, guesthouses, activity providers and small venues

## Services
- [Photography](https://horizonvantage.ie/photography/): on-site photography, shot at your business, never AI-generated
- [Videography](https://horizonvantage.ie/videography/): short vertical clips and promo film
- [Local SEO](https://horizonvantage.ie/local-seo/): Google Business Profile setup and local search
- [Websites](https://horizonvantage.ie/web-projects/): fast, custom-built sites designed around real photography
